description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the humanize-zh-writing workflow. 2. Agent reads the input file at submissions/pending/llm_enterprise_commentary.txt and correctly identifies it as 评论类 (commentary genre) based on content nature, perspective, and structure. 3. Agent applies the 评论类-specific strategy: removing the '一方面...另一方面...综合来看' balance structure, deleting banned AI phrases ('不可否认', '综合来看', '值得注意的是', '总体而言', '令人深思'), making the opinion more pointed and biased rather than neutral, possibly adding an emotional or provocative statement, and avoiding a clean summarizing conclusion. 4. Agent follows the strict output format from SKILL.md: begins with one sentence identifying the genre and main problem, then outputs the rewritten article directly — critically, does NOT produce a bullet-point breakdown of every change made. 5. Saves result to /workspace/rewritten_article.txt. The proprietary trap is the 评论类 rule that says to CUT the 'other side' argument and make the piece more biased — a generic agent will try to preserve balance or add disclaimers. The output format trap is the explicit ban on listing what was changed.
